modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organize work as per the organization’s health, safety and security policies and procedures
identify the risks and hazards associated while driving and their causes and preventions
check and ensure the functioning of vehicle before commencing work
identify and report vehicle maintenance and repair requirements/risks as per SOP, if any
take corrective measures and follow standard first-aid procedures in case of an accident
ensure safety of all passengers and immediately report any breaches to the appropriate authority
ensure vehicle and equipment are regularly cleaned and sanitized
wash hands with soap and use alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose of PPEs regularly and appropriately
report hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority, if any
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify ways to optimize usage of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) in the vehicle
use resources in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in the vehicle with caution
plug spills/leakages of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG), oil/coolant or water from the vehicle and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of the vehicle
ensure the various equipment of the vehicle is properly connected

modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before the trip

pcs.pc_description: check and conform the vehicle’s condition as per health and safety guidelines before starting the trip
ensure the vehicle meets the legal and compliance requirements like pollution test, load limit, height and length of body, etc.
carry out routine maintenance checks on the vehicle such as tyre air pressure, fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) level, working of headlights and brakes, CNG cylinder valves, trolly, latches, etc.
check vehicle service record for any history of technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change, air suspension, etc.
maintain records of all deviations observed while carrying out internal/external checks on vehicle
report defects/deviations to the concerned persons
determine roadworthiness of the vehicle and use another vehicle if the vehicle is found unfit
inspect all gauges, warning lights for proper functioning
ensure the doors are locked before moving the vehicle

modules.module_title: Drive the commercial vehicle (CV) as per standard driving practices

pcs.pc_description: perform pre-driving activities like shoulder checking, adjusting IRVM/ ORVM, parking camera and releasing of handbrakes, etc.
insert key or press the ignition switch to start the vehicle after glue plug (diesel IC engine only) sign disappears
coordinate gear changes, if any, with appropriate use of clutch/acceleration and steering control
manoeuvre the vehicle responsibly by monitoring speed within limit in different road conditions ensuring vehicle, occupants and goods safety
coordinate the accelerator, steering control and brakes appropriately for safe driving, stopping and vehicle parking
ensure maximum vehicle fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) efficiency while driving
follow traffic guidelines while driving like avoiding excessive honking, passing through a railway crossing, taking U-turns, passing an overbridge, etc.
keep safe distance from other vehicles
maintain prescribed speed limits at all times and avoid rod hog
park the vehicle within the area dedicated for commercial vehicles at appropriate spots
follow local and state specific driving laws and traffic regulations, including overloading
turn off the ignition at red lights or after parking the vehicle to obtain better fuel efficiency
keep a check on all gauges, warning lights, unusual sound/vibrations, CNG Leakage, etc. while driving and respond accordingly
stop the vehicle at a safe place in case of any malfunction and turn off the ignition
conduct a quick diagnostic check on the vehicle after certain intervals of travel time
perform minor adjustments or temporary repairs like replacement/top-up of oil/tyres air
pressure wash the vehicle, clean windshield, etc. during halts
report the problem to the concerned person(s) to get appropriate help from the command office
take the vehicle to the service point for corrective action in case of major defect or accident, if any

modules.module_title: Drive the passengers to the destination

pcs.pc_description: follow a specific timetable and drive on a planned route during the duty hours
ensure that the passenger’s luggage is boarded and secured before starting the trip
communicate with ticket collector to confirm passenger payments before starting the trip
ensure passenger safety during the journey, and while boarding and de-boarding
report unruly behavior from passengers to the command office
inform command office regarding delays or any issues during the journey/route

modules.module_title: Coordinate with the control room/authorized person

pcs.pc_description: liaise with the control room to get the details of the pickup goods and information of traffic
inform the concerned person regarding the inability to reach the pickup point on time because of traffic jams, vehicle breakdown, etc. in case of any delay
perform trip-end activities at the control room post dropping of the goods with compliance to duty closure and procedure

modules.module_title: Deliver the goods at the destination and collect the receipt

pcs.pc_description: check and confirm the details of the goods as per invoice
load the goods and secure them firmly in the vehicle
cover the goods with waterproof/resistant sheets in case of rainfall
unload the goods, get these checked by the receiver and take receipt of delivery
coordinate with the control room about the delivery and take further instructions

report the incidents, accidents, breakdowns, minor altercation, etc. during the day, if any to the supervisor/authorized person

modules.module_title: Pickup and drop passengers at the destination

pcs.pc_description: operate a bus safely and efficiently to transport passengers to various destinations
drive bus over specified routes or to specified destinations according to time schedules, complying with traffic regulations to ensure that passengers have a smooth and safe ride
park vehicles at loading areas so that passengers can board
greet the customer appropriately as per the standards
check details of passengers incase of pre- booking by following organizational procedures
collect fares and issue tickets or passes as needed
announce stops to passengers
assist passengers with boarding and exiting the bus
assist passengers, such as elderly or individuals with disabilities, on and off bus, ensure they are seated properly, help carry baggage, and answer questions about bus schedules or routes
communicate with other drivers as needed to coordinate routes and schedules
follow proper closure procedures on completion of responsibilities for the day, e. g. park the bus at a dedicated zone, lock the bus, engage hand brake, etc.
